column1: # Callers of the float setting accessor at 0x00403e20 in extradatalist.cpp
# The accessor's 32-bit form, which returned the address 4 bytes into the
# setting. No object defines it; a call whose argument is a setting of the
# shared class goes to the form that takes the shared Setting:
# batch, unit, function, the accessor. A sample: three readers of the HUD
# opacity setting g_011d9774, in two units, and one caller for each other
# argument form (a global under a unit name that a pragma maps to the
# setting, a setting of the 0x01017720 family, a generated float setting, a
# choice between two reinterpret_cast forms, a (float*) cast of a
# batch, unit, function, the accessor: every function of main.cpp that calls
# the accessor (VEGAS-122). They read fHavokTauRatio, fAnimationMult:General,
# the nine fLODFadeOut settings, fScopeScissorAmount:Display and
# batch, unit, function, the accessor: every function of blk_00940000_od.cpp
# that calls the accessor (VEGAS-122), since the unit's own empty Setting
# went. They read fHUDShakeMult:Interface, the scope and VATS camera
